newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices edge up, volume thins.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices edge up, volume thins.

text.p: U.S. energy futures edged up in quiet after-hours trade Thursday, with traders losing interest following the day session's lack of direction.
"It's such light volume, it's hard to tell if anything significant's moving it up," one trader said.
Crude oil futures on NYMEX ended the day seven cents higher at $19.42, as huge inventory builds were offset by forecasts that gasoline will rally soon on seasonal driving demand.
On ACCESS, the overnight futures exchange, May gasoline crept up 0.05 cents a gallon overnight to 60.75 cents as 75 lots traded in May and 160 lots in all months, several hours into the market.
Crude oil for May delivery traded $19.44 a barrel, up a slight two cents a barrel from the market close.
After-hours, NYMEX May heating oil traded at 54.20 cents, a 0.20-increase the final daytime trade, as volume reached 50 lots exchanged in May and 160 overall.
